# Adrian Erlikhman

> Adrian Erlikhman is a high-school senior at LACES in Los Angeles who does machine-learning and NLP research, builds ML and full-stack tools, and fences épée for Team USA. This is his personal site: https://adrianerlikhman.is-a.dev/

## Research

- LangLLM, "Do LLM Fingerprints Survive Outside English?": cross-lingual stylometric attribution of frontier LLMs. Co-first author; under review, IEEE BigData 2026 High School Symposium.
- CompLLM: LLM self-recognition measured against a peer baseline. Co-first author; in submission, TACL.
- [Legatum Prosperity Index robustness audit](https://adrianerlikhman.is-a.dev/papers/legatum-robustness-audit.pdf): co-first author with Ryan Erlikhman; accepted with revisions, Journal of High School Science.
- [Does Portfolio Optimization Beat Splitting Evenly?](https://adrianerlikhman.is-a.dev/papers/portfolio-optimization-vs-equal-weight.pdf): with Ryan Erlikhman; accepted with revisions, Oxford Journal of Student Scholarship.
- [Demos](https://adrianerlikhman.is-a.dev/demos/): guess which model wrote an essay; a stylometry toy.

## Fencing

- Épée, A26 rating, Team USA. U.S. Junior (U20) No. 49, U.S. Senior No. 78, U.S. Cadet peak No. 17, Region 4 No. 1.
